name: PMW
recent: PMW 获得 TNB 价值 RM64.37m 的混凝土电杆供应合约延伸，使合约总值达到 RM148.05m；同时公司与 Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation 的认购协议条件截止日延长至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收与净利均较上一季度增长。
notable: 获得 TNB 价值 RM64.37m 的混凝土电杆供应合约延伸，合约总值提高至 RM148.05m。
与 Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation 的认购及股东协议条件截止日延长六个月至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。
2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收与净利分别环比增长 74.9% 和 144.0%。
risks: 133,807,772 股普通股受锁定期协议约束，该协议于 2026 年 11 月 18 日到期。
与 STIDC 的认购协议条件尚未完全满足，截止日已延长至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 53.065m，环比增长 74.9%；净利为 MYR 4.993m，环比增长 144.0%；净利率从 6.7% 提升至 9.4%。

recent_en: PMW secured a RM64.37m extension to its TNB concrete pole supply contract, bringing the total contract value to RM148.05m; meanwhile, the conditions precedent period for its subscription agreement with Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation has been extended to 7 April 2027. Revenue and net profit both increased quarter-on-quarter in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Secured a RM64.37m extension to its TNB concrete pole supply contract, raising total contract value to RM148.05m.
Extended the conditions precedent deadline for its subscription and shareholders' agreement with Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation by six months to 7 April 2027.
Revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 74.9% and 144.0% quarter-on-quarter, respectively.
risks_en: 133,807,772 ordinary shares are subject to a lock-up agreement ending on 18 November 2026.
Conditions precedent under the STIDC subscription agreement have not been fully satisfied, with the deadline extended to 7 April 2027.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 53.065m, up 74.9% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 4.993m, up 144.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin improved from 6.7% to 9.4%.
